notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The route {{path}} does not exist or was moved.

validation.username: Use 3 to 50 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
validation.password: Must be 8 to 72 characters with at least one letter and one digit.
validation.notBeforeHiring: Cannot be before the hiring date.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Enter your username and password
signIn.value1: Projects, progress and costs in one place
signIn.value2: Invoicing with IGV, withholdings and deductions
signIn.value3: Weekly cash flow, actual and projected

signUp.subtitle: Register a user and their role
signUp.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot or hyphen
signUp.passwordHint: 8 to 72 characters, with letters and digits

users.subtitle: Roles and platform access
users.deactivateMessage: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Continue?

clients.subtitle: Companies we quote and invoice projects to
clients.formSubtitle: Register a company to quote and invoice projects

projects.subtitle: Project portfolio and progress
projects.name: Project
projects.estimatedDirectCostHint: Sum of the cost estimates by category (set in the detail)
projects.startMessage: {{code}} · {{name}} will move to In progress. Continue?
projects.cancelMessage: {{code}} · {{name}} will be cancelled and will not accept changes or progress. This cannot be undone. Continue?
projects.lockedMessage: This project is completed or cancelled and can no longer be edited.
projects.empty: There are no projects with this status.
projects.progressHint: Up to {{max}} % (what is left to reach 100 %)
projects.willComplete: This progress takes the project to 100 % and it will be completed.

invoices.subtitle: Issued invoices and their collection
invoices.empty: There are no invoices with this status.
invoices.issueSubtitle: Register an invoice for project progress
invoices.hasRetentionHint: The client withholds 3 % of the invoice total (withholding agent).
invoices.hasDetractionHint: 12 % of the total, rounded to whole soles; deposited in the detractions account.
invoices.selfDetractionHint: The company deposits the detraction instead of the client. Requires a detraction.
invoices.advanceHint: Client advance; recognized as revenue when the project is completed.
invoices.previewNote: Reference calculation with the rates in force since {{date}}. The official amount is calculated when issuing.
invoices.previewNoteStandard: Reference calculation with the standard rates (IGV 18 %, detraction 12 %, withholding 3 %). The official amount is calculated when issuing.
invoices.voidOnlyWithoutPayments: Only invoices without payments can be voided
invoices.voidMessage: Invoice {{number}} will be voided and will not accept payments. This cannot be undone. Continue?

collections.subtitle: Collections expected per week of the month
collections.empty: There are no scheduled collections this month.
collections.cancelMessage: The week {{week}} collection ({{project}}) will be cancelled and can no longer change. Continue?

expenses.subtitle: Project costs and general expenses
expenses.annulMessage: "{{description}}" for {{total}} will be annulled. It stays on record as annulled and no longer counts in totals. This cannot be undone.
expenses.newSubtitle: Register a project cost or a general expense
expenses.editSubtitle: Only the category, the project and the description can be corrected
expenses.projectHint: Empty = general expense, not a direct cost
expenses.fixedNote: To fix the amount, the voucher or the payment, annul the expense and register it again.
expenses.noVoucherHint: An expense without voucher has no number
expenses.amountIncludesIgvHint: The base is split from the IGV starting from the total.
expenses.onlyInvoiceHint: Only an invoice gives tax credit and splits IGV.
expenses.paidHint: Otherwise a payable is left for Treasury.
expenses.previewNote: Indicative figures with the rates in force since {{date}}. The system calculates the official amount when registering.
expenses.previewNoteStandard: Indicative figures with 18 % IGV. The system calculates the official amount when registering.
expenses.previewNoteNoIgv: Without an invoice there is no IGV: the total is the base.
expenses.previewNoteEdit: Amounts already registered; they cannot be changed.
expenses.noPaymentAccess: Registering an expense requires choosing the account or partner that paid, and your role cannot read them. Ask Administration or Accounting to register it.

suppliers.subtitle: Companies and people the company buys from
suppliers.formSubtitle: Register a supplier to link it to your expenses
suppliers.rucOptional: 11 digits; optional for a natural person

employees.subtitle: People on the payroll
employees.formSubtitle: Add a person to the payroll
employees.terminateMessage: {{name}} will no longer be active from the date you enter (hired on {{hiredOn}}). This cannot be undone and the employee can no longer be edited.
employees.terminatedNotice: This employee is terminated and can no longer be edited.

fixedCosts.subtitle: Recurring monthly payments
fixedCosts.formSubtitle: Recurring monthly payment of the company
fixedCosts.codeHint: Unique; the next CF code is proposed
fixedCosts.employeeHint: Required when the type is Salary
fixedCosts.employeeRequired: A salary fixed cost requires an employee.
fixedCosts.expectedWeeksHint: Weeks of the month the payment is expected in; they feed the projected cash flow.
fixedCosts.inactiveNotice: This fixed cost is inactive: it can no longer be edited or paid.
fixedCosts.accountHint: Without an account no cash outflow is posted in Treasury.
fixedCosts.deactivateMessage: {{code}} · {{concept}} will no longer count in the monthly total and can no longer be paid or edited. This cannot be undone.

bankAccounts.subtitle: Bank and cash balances
bankAccounts.formSubtitle: Register a bank account or petty cash
bankAccounts.accountNumberHint: Unique; for petty cash it can be a name, like "Petty cash"
bankAccounts.balanceNote: Balances are calculated from the registered movements.
bankAccounts.balanceFormNote: The current balance comes from the movements; it is never edited by hand.
bankAccounts.toAccountHint: Another account in the same currency
bankAccounts.negativeWarning: The origin account will go below zero. The system allows it; check before confirming.
bankAccounts.directionRequired: Choose whether it is an inflow or an outflow.
bankAccounts.adjustmentConceptHint: Explain why: the adjustment stays in the account history.

payables.subtitle: Pending obligations by week
payables.accountHint: Required: the payment leaves this account.
payables.formSubtitle: An obligation to pay in a week of the month
payables.cashFlowNote: It is used to project the cash flow.
payables.doubleCostNotice: If it is a purchase with a voucher, register it in Expenses as pending: its payable is created by itself. Registering it here too would book the cost twice in Accounting.

loans.subtitle: Loans received and granted
loans.empty: There are no loans of this type.
loans.formSubtitle: Money the company borrowed or lent
loans.helpReceived: The company receives the money: it goes into the chosen account on the disbursement date.
loans.helpGranted: The company hands the money out: it leaves the chosen account on the disbursement date.
loans.counterpartyHintReceived: Who lends the money, for example a bank.
loans.counterpartyHintGranted: Who the money is lent to.
loans.interestRateHint: Informative only: the interest comes from the installments.
loans.accountHintReceived: PEN account the money goes into.
loans.accountHintGranted: PEN account the money comes out of.
loans.negativeBalanceNotice: This account would end up with a negative balance ({{balance}}). You can still register the loan.
loans.installmentsNote: Installments are scheduled from the loan detail.
loans.unscheduledNotice: {{amount}} of the capital is still to be scheduled.
loans.noInstallments: This loan has no installments yet.
loans.dueBeforeDisbursement: It cannot be before the disbursement.
loans.exceedsUnscheduled: It cannot exceed the capital to schedule ({{amount}}).
loans.payHintReceived: The installment total leaves this account.
loans.payHintGranted: The installment total comes into this account.
loans.negativeBalancePayNotice: This account would end up with a negative balance ({{balance}}). You can still register the payment.

partners.subtitle: What the partners put into the company
partners.reimbursableHint: When the company will pay it back: it is a debt to the partner, not capital.
partners.noContributions: There are no contributions in this period.
partners.accountHint: PEN account the money goes into.
partners.expenseNote: If the partner paid an expense with their own money, register it in Expenses with the "Partner contribution" payment method.

ledgerAccounts.subtitle: The company accounts
ledgerAccounts.name: Name
ledgerAccounts.empty: There are no accounts of this type.
ledgerAccounts.codeHint: 2 to 10 digits; it does not start with 0.
ledgerAccounts.codePattern: Use 2 to 10 digits, not starting with 0.
ledgerAccounts.codeInUse: There is already a ledger account with that code.
ledgerAccounts.typeHint: Proposed from the first digit (1–3 asset, 4 liability, 5 equity, 6 expense, 7 revenue); you can change it.
